cutoff_system.graphs: nested finite oriented graphs G_i subset G_j
cutoff_system.edge_identity: old oriented edges retain labels and orientation
cutoff_system.forest_choice: choose spanning forests T_i nested under inclusion; extend T_i to T_j without deleting old tree edges
cutoff_system.existence: every forest in a finite graph extension can be extended to a spanning forest

cycle_port.coordinate: coefficient on each chord after tree-cycle decomposition
cycle_port.fundamental_cycle: one oriented chord plus its unique tree path

transition.inclusion: old chord coordinates embed with zero new-chord coordinates
transition.composition: coordinate inclusions and projections compose over three cutoffs
transition.history_augmentation: if B_i transitions compatibly, then (B_i,Z_i) retains every old finite-cutoff distinction

metric.synthetic_candidate: identity covariance in the chosen chord basis
metric.transition: principal-block compatible under nested fixed forests
metric.forest_dependence: a different spanning forest changes the fundamental-cycle basis by an integral invertible matrix that need not be orthogonal
metric.consequence: the identity chord metric is not canonical and cannot be promoted to a source-derived calibrated metric

next_required_object.acceptance: declare graph inclusions and target Hilbert maps U_ji with U_ji B_i=B_j inclusion, track cutoff constants, and combine with the cycle-port transition; metric calibration remains separate
